msg: Good afternoon. My name is Anna, I am from Germany. I will stay at the Hotel San Pedro de Majagua on Isla Grande from November 20 to 24. I am a PADI Advanced diver with about 80 dives, my last dive was in September in Egypt. How does it work when I am already on the island: do you pick me up at the hotel, and what does it cost? I would like to dive on two of the days.
reply:
Hi, Anna! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Good afternoon, Anna! Diving from Isla Grande is a lovely way to explore the reef, and San Pedro de Majagua is one of our base hotels. Pick-up and return by boat are included at no extra charge, and your pick-up is confirmed there.

For two days of diving, the *4-dive package* includes two daytime dives each day. Pick-up is between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m.; you’ll return to the hotel around 12:00–1:00 p.m. Lunch isn’t included for island-based plans. I’m leaving the prices below.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 3 daytime + 1 night dive): 236 USD · 262 USD
• 5-dive package (2 days): 319 USD · 354 USD

From the islands we coordinate pick-up and drop-off at your hotel if it has maritime access, or at the nearest dock we point you to.

Would you like to book this package?

msg: Yes, the 4-dive package with daytime dives sounds right, on November 22 and 23. My flight home leaves Cartagena on November 24 at 16:00. Is this safe after diving? And could I go with your boat from the island to Cartagena that morning, or do I need to arrange this myself? I also have one large suitcase.
reply:
Yes, your flight on November 24 at 4:00 p.m. is more than 18 hours after your last daytime dive on November 23, so it meets the minimum post-dive wait time.

The 4-dive package ends around 12:00–1:00 p.m. each day, with pick-up at San Pedro de Majagua between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m. if the hotel has boat access. Returning to Cartagena on November 24 is not included in the package; a team advisor would need to arrange a separate boat return. I don’t have information about bringing a large suitcase on that boat, so that would need to be confirmed with an advisor.

How many people would this be for: just you, or more? 😊

msg: Just me. How can I book and pay? I would also like a price for the boat back to Cartagena on the 24th, if you can tell me.
reply:
You can book the 4-dive package through the online booking link shown below. As an international guest, payment is 100% by card on the website; use your passport as the ID document. Payment is recorded right away, and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm your booking. If the booking system or online payment fails, the team can send a bank-transfer payment link and you’ll keep the 10% online discount; otherwise, payment by transfer isn’t available.

Returning to Cartagena on a different day isn’t included in the package. A team advisor needs to arrange the boat return for November 24 and confirm its price. Would you like me to connect you with an advisor about the return boat and your large suitcase?

🤿 *4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives) - already on the islands*
💰 *204 USD* per person
✅ Includes: hotel pick-up (if there is maritime/boat access), dive insurance, diving equipment and a PADI professional accompanying the activity.
📍 Pickup at your island hotel.
